title: Painted field terminal

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production raster UI skin, one square nine-slice panel texture for a painterly military industrial retrofuturist game's conversation terminal.
Primary request: a battered field-terminal faceplate, dirty but carefully readable.
Composition: exactly straight-on orthographic front surface, square 1024 by 1024. The object fills the entire image edge to edge. Narrow continuous metal bezel occupying only the outer 7 percent on each side, with small slotted screws contained in the four corner squares. The inner 86 percent is one uninterrupted flat dark desaturated olive-green painted metal surface, quiet enough to put cream interface text over it.
Style: hand-painted game art, visible broad soft gouache/oil brushwork and deliberate painted edge highlights, like an illustrated 1960s military communications console. NOT photorealistic, NOT vector, NOT a clean 3D render.
Materials: chipped olive enamel, small exposed dull steel nicks, a little oily brown grime and charcoal rubbed dirt mostly around the outer rim, subtle warm brass oxidation at corner hardware. Rounded inner bevel, restrained scratches.
The broad center must remain dark, low contrast, empty and calm, with very subtle brushed paint wear only. The center has no openings, panels, controls, vents, seams, ornament or bright marks. Bezel straight along each side so the side strips can stretch independently.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no UI contents, no portraits, no buttons, no screens, no perspective, no cast shadow outside the image, no background beyond the object, no bright neon, no hazard stripes. Opaque texture.
assets.role: Nine-slice olive enamel shell and worn control surfaces

assets.prompt:
